- Provide a fallback/failover plan (backup signers or an alternative envelope) in case the primary signer is unavailable during the window.

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — final redlines accepted; next steps for signatures

Elena — thanks and congrats on getting this across the finish line. Short plan below; happy to adjust.

Proposed signing choreography (Redwood-initiated):
1) Primary envelope (Envelope A) — sequential signing via DocuSign: Redwood exec (COO) -> Atlas GC -> Atlas CEO. Authentication: email + SMS OTP for Atlas GC (we can add ID check on request).
2) Fallback envelope (Envelope B) — pre-staged and ready to launch if any primary signer is unavailable after T+12 hours. This uses the same document set but routes to the backup signatory (Atlas VP Finance) in place of CEO.
3) Parallel witness/acknowledgement — for EMEA approver we will create an acknowledgement CC-only step (not a signer) to capture timestamp and locale-specific metadata.
4) Post-sign: Redwood will export the completed envelope, apply clean-copy stamping, and push a signed PDF to the shared Drive folder above. We'll also publish the clean copy to the contracts Confluence page for archival.

Attachments: routing_map_v1.pdf — includes the mapping of signer emails, order of signing, and fallback triggers.

Timing recommendation: initiate Envelope A on Dec 9 at 09:00 PT. If we don't have full completion within 48 hours, Envelope B is automatically activated (manual step by Redwood Legal Ops if you prefer).

Open items for your confirmation:
- Confirm the backup signatory (name and email) for the fallback envelope.
- Confirm whether Atlas wants embedded ID verification for the CEO or GC. That affects the signer flow and may require DocuSign ID verification (extra step).

I'll wait for your quick confirmation and then coordinate with Marissa and Vanessa to prepare the envelopes and the DocuSign recipient list.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachment: routing_map_v1.pdf)
